The '''Manaan Atrocities''' was an event that occurred sometime before the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. [[Blood Company commander|An alien warlord]] who later led the [[Blood Company]] was known to have participated in the event.
